If you have kids heading back to school or off to college, the back-to-school sales season is a perfect time to pick up some tech to help them tackle their assignments.

Apple kicked off its own back-to-school promotion last month, offering a US$150 gift card with the purchase of a qualifying Mac or iPad; Amazon also has some solid deals.

We've rounded up the following tech products suitable for students heading back to school.

inateck AceTouch — an ultra-lightweight, colorful keyboard case designed for iPad

If you're looking for an affordable way to add a case, screen cover, stand and keyboard to your iPad, the inateck AceTouch has you covered. It can transform your iPad into a travel-ready laptop, letting you work from anywhere.

A keyboard is the best accessory to boost your iPad's productivity, and the AceTouch is fully featured, with a Mac-inspired design, function keys, and a clickable trackpad (98x55mm) that supports all Apple shortcuts. You can use the trackpad to drag, scroll, zoom, swipe between full-screen apps and more. A palm-rejection feature prevents accidental touches.

Snap it on for laptop mode, snap it off for tablet mode.

The magnetic detachable design lets the keyboard attach automatically, and detaching takes just a second. Paired with a flexible stand adjustable from 20 to 70 degrees, it supports both landscape and portrait viewing angles — one case for every use case.

The AceTouch is 200 grams lighter than other full-featured keyboards, weighing in at just 450 grams and only 0.3 inches thick. It features scissor switches with a 1.5mm short key travel for fast, comfortable typing. Light enough to slip into any bag for daily carry.

Compatible with the iPad (A16) 11th generation, 10th-generation iPad, 10.9-inch iPad Air (4th and 5th generation), 11-inch iPad Air (M2 to M4), and 11-inch iPad Pro (1st through 4th generation).

Pick your color. Show your style. With a modern minimalist design and nine vibrant colors, it's slim, light, and full of personality for your iPad.

Anker Nano Power Strip

The Anker Nano Power Strip is a compact ten-in-one device that lets you power up all your Apple gear from your desk.

A clever clamp design lets you secure it exactly where you want it — sturdy and stable, with the main unit tucked away under the desk. The exposed part is smaller than an iPhone 17 Pro Max and thinner than AirPods Pro 3.

You can charge your MacBook, monitor, iPad, iPhone, AirPods and more simultaneously, using a combination of power outlets and USB ports. GaN charging technology delivers up to 70W output, with built-in surge and overload protection that cuts power instantly if overloaded, keeping all your devices safe.

ESR 3-in-1 Charging Station

If you're after a space-saving bedside charging solution for your essential Apple devices, the ESR 3-in-1 Charging Station can charge your iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods case all at once.

The Qi 2.2 charger delivers up to 25W for the latest iPhone models, and is of course compatible with all earlier MagSafe iPhones. Built-in CryoBoost cooling keeps your phone's temperature down while charging, extending battery life. The fan can be switched off for quiet overnight use.

Compatible with all Apple Watch models and all AirPods cases with wireless charging. This device also makes a great travel charger, folding down to 4.33 x 2.44 x 0.62 inches.

Apple AirPods Max 2

The AirPods Max 2 is the latest generation of Apple's premium over-ear headphones, featuring Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Adaptive Audio, Personalized Spatial Audio, Live Translation and more.

The headphones feature a breathable knit-mesh headband, memory foam, custom-fabric ear cushions, and adjustable-length sliding arms for the perfect blend of comfort and fit. They're available in five vibrant colors.

Anker Soundcore Liberty 5

AirPods are undeniably one of the most popular in-ear headphones around, but if you're after a more affordable option, the Anker Soundcore Liberty 5 noise-cancelling earbuds are a solid pick.

They combine real-time adaptive active noise cancellation, fast charging and long-lasting battery life. On the audio side, hi-res audio, LDAC, HearID Sound 4.0 and Dolby Audio work together to deliver richer, more layered sound. For calls, six microphones paired with AI-enhanced active noise cancellation keep conversations clearer. Multipoint connectivity lets you switch between devices quickly and easily.

The earbuds deliver up to 12 hours of playtime on a single charge, extending to 48 hours with the charging case. A 10-minute fast charge gives you 5 hours of use.

AirTags 4-Pack (2nd Generation)

AirTags are a lifesaver for keeping track of your wallet, camera and other valuables or important items when you're out and about. This deal lets you pick up the latest 2nd-generation 4-pack at a great price.

MagSafe PopSockets

PopSockets are among the most popular iPhone accessories right now, giving you a secure one-handed grip on your iPhone while doubling as a stand.

The metallic enamel finish gives it a clean, premium look, with a wide range of colors and patterns to choose from.

Oeli XTREM iPhone Case with E-Ink Display

Last up is something a bit more fun. The Oeli XTREM is a one-of-a-kind iPhone case: it comes with a built-in e-ink display that you can customize via a dedicated app.

It doesn't need a battery — instead, it's powered by your phone via NFC. The e-ink screen uses no power to display images, only when refreshing, so it has minimal impact on your phone's battery life.

You can pick your own photos, or choose designs created by other members of the app's community. You can also mirror your phone's screen onto the case and take selfies with the rear camera.
